blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: Project Q must be done; the planners do not mind which year of its window, 2028 to 2030. Which row states the rule?

options.text: x_Q,2028 = 1, fixing the window's first year
options.says: The page: fixing one year makes the planners choose it, which the model does better.

options.text: the sum of x_Q,t over its window at most 1
options.says: That is the once row every project has; it forces nothing.

options.text: no row: raise v_Q until the plan starts Q
options.says: The page: raising the value forces nothing and inflates the plan's value.

options.text: the sum of x_Q,t over its window equal to 1
options.says: Right: started in exactly one year, chosen by the model.

origin.section: The Design Decision: an Equality Row, Not a Fixed Variable

questions.stem: An override arrives with the reason '\t ' (a tab and a space), and the check is written `if not reason:`. What happens?

options.text: It is refused, since a tab counts as no text at all
options.says: The page: `not` of a string is False whenever it is not empty; a tab is an ordinary character.

options.text: It is accepted, since Python treats the string as true
options.says: Right: only strip() makes white space count as no reason.

options.text: It is refused, since strip() runs before the check
options.says: The check as written has no strip(): the page says that without it, a check written `if not reason` lets any such string through.

options.text: It raises a TypeError, since a tab is not valid text
options.says: The page: testing the string raises nothing, not even a TypeError.

origin.section: The Change: Four Requirements, One Row Family, One Check

questions.stem: A change validates, and its tasks.md still has three unchecked boxes. What does OpenSpec's archive do?

options.text: It refuses, until every box in tasks.md is checked
options.says: The page: archive warns and does not block.

options.text: It archives, but keeps the deltas out of the living specs
options.says: The page: the archive updated specs/capital-plan/spec.md, and the living spec now states the new scenario.

options.text: It warns about the open tasks, then archives the change
options.says: Right: a warning, not a block.

options.text: It archives silently, since tasks lie outside the format
options.says: The page: archive warns about unchecked tasks.

origin.section: Archive Warns About the Open Tasks, and Does Not Block
